tools.name: ask
tools.description: Search seahawkmedia.com: services, solutions, guides, best-of lists, articles, glossary terms and company pages. Returns the most relevant pages with title, URL and description, ranked. Ask in plain words, e.g. "wordpress maintenance plans" or "migrate from wix".

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one seahawkmedia.com page as markdown (its main content, links made absolute). Pass a full URL or a site path such as /services/website-care/.

url.description: A seahawkmedia.com URL or a path starting with /.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Who Seahawk Media is, every service and solution with its description, starting price and URL, the Seahawk brands, and how to get in touch. The same text as /llms-full.txt.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: How to reach Seahawk Media: email, phone numbers, offices, the contact page and the booking link for a call (with which team to book for which need). Use this to help someone start a project or ask a question; it does not send anything.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Run Seahawk's free website checker on any public page: HTTP status, HTTPS and redirect, security headers, SEO basics (title, description, headings, canonical, robots), WordPress detection with theme and plugins, and optionally the status of every link on the page. Same as https://seahawkmedia.com/tools/seo-checker/.

url.description: A public website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page/.

check_links.description: Also check each link on the page (slower).

tools.name: test_page_speed
tools.description: Measure a public page with Google PageSpeed Insights: performance score, lab Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, TBT, FCP, speed index, TTFB), real-user field data where Google has it, and the biggest opportunities. Takes up to a minute. Same as https://seahawkmedia.com/tools/website-speed-test/.
